about.lead: I'm Aryan Sahu — a curious builder with a passion for technology, creativity, and turning ideas into reality.
about.body: I'm exploring the world of software and digital experiences, learning by creating real projects and improving with every challenge. I believe progress comes from staying curious, experimenting, and pushing beyond what I already know. This portfolio captures what I'm building today and the possibilities I'm working toward.

education.institution: Columbia Institute of Engineering & Technology (CIET), Raipur
education.description: Currently pursuing my college education at Columbia Institute of Engineering & Technology, located in Tekari, Raipur, Chhattisgarh, affiliated with Chhattisgarh Swami Vivekanand Technical University (CSVTU), Bhilai.

skills.intro: A growing toolkit, built through curiosity, experimentation, and the determination to reach higher.
